stem: Which of these events from the story causes Otis to consider giving Opal a job?

options.label: A
options.text: Opal finds a leash and a collar that Winn-Dixie likes.

options.label: B
options.text: Otis explains that the parrot does not like being around dogs.

options.label: C
options.text: Otis learns that Winn-Dixie howls when he is away from Opal.

options.label: D
options.text: Opal mentions some chores that she could do at the pet store.
